'''Habbala Brupt''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] and a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
Habbala was fleeing his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] as a passenger on a transport heading to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Unfortunately, during the trip, the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was boarded by the Empire and subjected to a search. The boarding party found [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] sympathizers aboard, and the Imperial [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in charge of the operation ordered the extermination of everyone on the ship. The Sullustan begged for his life and offered to do anything in exchange for mercy. The Imperial officer considered the value of a spy from a [[Species/Legends|species]] not known to indulge in such activities. The boarding party chose to spare Habbala's life, unlike any others on the transport ship.<ref name="Coruscant and the Core Worlds" />

The Imperials assigned Habbala to [[N'zoth]], the homeworld of the xenophobic [[Yevetha]] species. Eventually he found [[Werstilhere]], an offworlder settlement on N'zoth, and settled there with hope to find a means to leave the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and return to the Empire.<ref name="Coruscant and the Core Worlds" />
